narrative.overview:
A near-black engineering surface, hairline-ruled, that reads like the flat, orthogonal chrome around a piece of equipment rather than a stack of paper cards. One continuous ambient field (`WaveField`) breathes behind it. It is the only thing in the interface with depth, perspective, or continuous motion, and everything in front of it is deliberately flat: opacity, `y`, `scale`, `clip-path`. Every reveal, stagger and transport pulse is timed off a single BPM-92 grid (`beats()`), a structural nod to the music half of the site rather than a literal audio cue.

Density is high but never cramped. Text is a four-role scale (lead / body / meta / micro) and every prose block carries a measure cap. Colour is rationed to three greys and one blue, and the blue is split by role: shapes get `--accent`, words get the brighter `--accent-text`, so restraint is enforced by contrast math, not taste.

Nothing is decoration for its own sake. A shadow exists only where it does a job a hairline cannot. A rule draws instead of fading, because the site is built out of hairlines and letting them draw turns the page's own structure into the animation. The one texture is a **halftone dither**: an 8px dot grid gated by a 4x4 Bayer matrix, used by exactly three things (the wave field, the cursor glow, the loader) and nowhere else.
keyCharacteristics: **Flat and orthogonal in the foreground, volumetric in one background layer.** `WaveField` is the sole place depth, defocus and continuous motion live.
**Hairlines, not cards.** No elevation system, no card component, nothing rounder than `rounded-sm`.
**Three greys, one blue, split by role.** `--accent` for shapes, `--accent-text` for words.
**One timing grid.** `beats()` off BPM 92 for choreography, two springs for anything a hand touches, one press curve (`--ease-press`, 120ms) for controls.
**Dither as the single texture.** Halftone belongs to `WaveField`, `CursorGlow` and the loader. Swapping lines for dots anywhere else was tried and rejected.

**Each surface reveals according to what it is.** Rows follow their rule on `/builds`, the contact sheet develops on `/lens`, the history builds as a spine on `/`. A generic fade-and-rise is the thing that would cheapen all of it.

rules.name: The Accent/Accent-Text Split Rule
rules.body: The brand blue is under the text floor on this background. `--accent` is for what is seen; `--accent-text` is required the moment the blue is read. Exception: white text on an `--accent` fill (the primary button) clears 5.17:1 because the contrast is against the fill, not the page.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: The accent is the only blue any control, rule, icon or word uses. The wave field tints its three layers from white toward `37, 99, 235` and draws accent dots at `rgba(68,120,238,0.38)` / neutral dots at `rgba(200,205,220,0.21)`; those are canvas pixels, not interface colours, and must not be sampled for anything else. There is no violet, no seam gradient and no second hue anywhere.

rules.name: The No-Opacity-Dimming Rule
rules.body: `text-dim` and `text-dim2` are colours chosen to clear 4.5:1. `text-fg/70` is a guess at one. Two sanctioned opacity uses exist and neither is text: `bg-fg/40` for the bullet dot, `bg-white/[0.025]` for an active music row.

rules.name: The Accent Seam Rule
rules.body: The only gradient is the 1px hairline under project media (`ProjectCard`, `FeaturedProject`): `--accent` fading through 38-42% of itself to transparent. It draws left to right. No gradient fills, no gradient text.

rules.name: The Token Scale Rule
rules.body: Every size, leading, measure and tracking value is a token in `globals.css`; a component references the role it needs. A hand-picked `text-[0.93rem]` at a callsite is the defect the scale replaced.

rules.name: The No-Breakpoint-Size Rule
rules.body: Display tiers scale by `clamp()`. A heading is the same size on every route at every width. An `sm:` or `lg:` size step on a display element is a defect.

rules.name: The No-800 Rule
rules.body: Clash Display has no 800. `font-extrabold` on a display element would be synthesized by the browser, not rendered.

rules.name: The Uncapped Prose Rule
rules.body: Prose without a measure cap is a bug. Caps are in `ch`, so they hold at any zoom.

rules.name: The Poster Scale Exception
rules.body: `--size-meta-poster` (11rem), `--text-meta-ribbon` (1.3125rem) and `--text-meta-stack` (2.25rem) exist solely for the noindex render surfaces `/meta-image` and `/linkedin-banner`, which are fixed-size 1200x630 and 1584x396 canvases that get exported to images. They are not site roles; do not use them in routes.

rules.name: The Brand Mark
rules.body: `public/brand-mark.svg` is one all-white ligature of the actual Clash Display Bold numerals `1`, `5`, `2` (the `1` enters the `5` at full stroke, the `2` paints last so its shoulder absorbs the lower junction), scaled to 66% of its construction square. The Sidebar renders it transparent at 32x32 through `next/image` with `unoptimized`. The raster icon family (`app/icon.png`, `app/apple-icon.png`, public 192/512 PNGs) mounts the same master on an opaque `--bg` square; `app/favicon.ico` packs a 32px render plus a pixel-hinted 16px. It is a brand composition, not a text role.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. No shadow as card elevation, ever.

rules.name: The Defocus Rule
rules.body: To put one thing behind another, soften it. Do not darken it and do not shadow the one in front.

rules.name: The One Ambient Layer Rule
rules.body: `WaveField` is the site's only continuous ambient motion. A second animated layer in the same plane, however quiet, makes both read as clutter. Make the field perceptible by raising filament opacity, never by adding a layer above it. `CursorGlow` is pointer feedback, not ambience: it mounts only for a precise pointer, tracks it 1:1, and has no idle position, drift or audio reactivity.

rules.name: The Rules-Draw Rule
rules.body: Rules draw; they never fade. `DrawnRule` scales a 1px line from an origin over ~0.8s, starting `240px` above the fold (roughly three-quarters of a laptop viewport) so the draw finishes where the reader is looking. A rule within 240px of the end of the document is detected on mount and resize and rendered already present.

rules.name: The No-Pill Rule
rules.body: No pill, chip, capsule or rounded-container tag. Skill tags are text.

dos: **Do** separate surfaces with a hairline (`--border`, `--rule`) or nothing.
**Do** use `--accent` for shapes and `--accent-text` for words.
**Do** keep `WaveField` as the one ambient layer, and halftone as the texture of `WaveField`, `CursorGlow` and the loader only.
**Do** source type from the four text roles and four display tiers in `globals.css`, with a measure cap on prose.
**Do** time choreography with `beats()` and `EASE_OUT`, hand-driven motion with `SPRING_UI` / `SPRING_MOMENTUM`, and presses with `--ease-press` at 120ms.
**Do** give every new surface a reveal that fits what it is (a rule leading, a sheet developing, a spine building).
**Do** respect `useMotionPreference()` and keep drags tracking under reduced motion.
**Do** put a visible `focus-visible` outline (`outline-2 outline-offset-4 outline-accent`) on every interactive element, and a 24px minimum hit area.
**Do** route per-route metadata through `routeMetadata()` so OG and Twitter images survive the replace-not-merge behaviour.
**Do** treat the site's content as typed data under `app/lib/data/`, and keep generated files (`beat-durations.ts`, `photo-dims.generated.ts`) generated.
donts: **Don't** dim text with an opacity modifier.
**Don't** use a shadow as card elevation; the four named shadows are the whole list.

**Don't** add a second animated background, pinned scroll sequence, or a dotted `RouteSignal`, loader texture, hero line, scroll rail or `BeatBars`: all were tried and read worse than the solid strokes.
**Don't** introduce a fifth text size, a hand-picked literal such as `text-[0.93rem]`, or an `sm:` / `lg:` size step on a display element.
**Don't** use a radius above `rounded-sm`, a pill, a gradient fill, or gradient text.
**Don't** invent per-component durations, or fade a rule where it should draw.
**Don't** add a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
**Don't** add a semantic colour (error red, success green). The palette has one blue.
**Don't** add a proficiency level, rating or tier to skills.
**Don't** put the Poster Scale tokens, `LoaderMatrix` or `intensity` above 1 on a real route.
**Don't** demote `Builds`, `Music` or `Lens` into a footnote: range is the claim.
